messages:
Lina CSM: Quick roundup from renewals/onboard syncs today — pulling raw signals w/ suggested triage. Main themes: CSV export schema variability, per-route billing opacity, embeddings similarity drift on long-context prompts, docs confusing for workspace perms, enablement gap on webhook retries, one renewal flagged (NovaHealth) citing unexpected token costs. Threading details below.

Ravi CS Ops: can you attach the NovaHealth export they sent? Need to see column names.

Lina CSM: pasted sanitized CSV header below
order_id,customer_id,items,total_price,discount_code,created_at,redwood_tokens_used
They expected separate line_items JSON column but we flatten — caused mismatch w/ their ETL.

Evan (PM): noted. Product question: do we support configurable export schemas? If not, add to backlog as "export-schema-templates". What's customer impact: renewal at risk?

Lina CSM: NovaHealth said 30% of their onboarding mapping fails, renewal conversation in 18 days. Risk: medium-high. Also 5 other customers asked for line_items.

Tara (Solutions): For the webhook/retry gap — we have a doc but it's buried. Customers want a retry/backoff example and idempotency key suggestion. I'll draft a snippet.

Ravi CS Ops: counts from this week: 6 accounts reported export schema mismatch, 9 asked about per-route cost visibility, 3 flagged tokenization trimming on 4k+ prompts, 2 reported embeddings drift when company-specific prefix injected.

Evan (PM): prioritization proposal: (1) NovaHealth export template (patch + quick migration guide) - P0 (customer at risk), (2) per-route cost UI perf tweak - P1, (3) embeddings probe + quantization audit - P1, (4) webhook/enablement examples - P2. Anyone object?

Tara (Solutions): agree. For migration guide I'll include SQL snippets and an example newline-delimited JSON transform. Example code block I will start from: ```bash
jq -c '.line_items[]' orders.json > line_items.ndjson
```

Lina CSM: NovaHealth asked for a one-off export while they update ETL — can eng run a CSV transform for them? It's time-sensitive.

Evan (PM): we can offer a manual export as a one-time service. @Ravi can you confirm availability?

Ravi CS Ops: I can coordinate SRE/Eng for a manual export if Eng approves. Will need dataset ID and retention window.

triage-bot: Triage card created: TRG-2026. Meeting scheduled: 2025-03-22 16:00 PT. Invite sent to participants.

Jordan (cc'd via PM): pinging eng leads — for embeddings drift we need a small repro set (orig, prefixed) and model variant. If quantized variant shows regression, consider temporary routing to fp16.

Lina CSM: attaching two representative pairs inline: pairA sim(orig,prefixed)=0.81 -> expected 0.92; pairB sim=0.68 -> expected 0.86. Both on model emb-xlarge-q8.

Evan (PM): action items before triage meeting: 1) Ravi — consolidated account counts + NovaHealth raw file; 2) Tara — draft webhook retry guide + sample code; 3) Eng — confirm manual export feasibility + share repro harness for embeddings. We'll use impact x effort matrix in meeting.

Tara (Solutions): I'll also record a 5min enablement clip to send to NovaHealth if they opt for migration.

Lina CSM: thanks team — goal is "ship quick export template + migration guide" within 72 hrs, temp mitigation for NovaHealth, and embedding investigation on 1-week cadence. :white_check_mark:
